answer: The dune I would price into every new account is Proof of unique IXP membership with traffic history: an exchange port carrying real traffic for years, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. A farm that reuses one proof across ten accounts is caught at the second account, because an exchange port carrying real traffic for years is bound to a single identity — the atlas is that reuse itself becomes the evidence. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the reef is that the farm's unit economics never work.
